name: pr-review
description: On a pull request, run staticcheck (lint), gosec (SAST) and govulncheck (SCA), post their results as markdown-table PR comments, then run a code review and a security review whose findings (issues, vulns, and recommendations) are posted as further PR comments. Trigger with inputs {repo, number, ref, sha}: repo is the git-factory repo NAME under ops/, number the PR number, ref the PR source branch, sha its head commit. The reviewers read the tree at the PR head plus the scan/ reports and write a markdown findings table which a Go poster (embedded, go-run in the scan image) posts via git-factory's PR comments API.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: git-factory repo name within the namespace

with.run: set -e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false; git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; git clone -q "$GIT_URL" /workspace; cd /workspace; git checkout -q "${inputs.ref}" 2>/dev/null || git checkout -q "${inputs.sha}" 2>/dev/null || true; echo cloned; git log --oneline -1

export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/gocache/build GOMODCACHE=/gocache/mod GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false && mkdir -p /gocache/build /gocache/mod; cd /workspace && mkdir -p scan; (go run honnef.co/go/tools/cmd/staticcheck@latest ./... > scan/lint.txt 2>&1 || true); (go run github.com/securego/gosec/v2/cmd/gosec@latest -quiet -fmt=json -out=scan/sast.json ./... 2>/dev/null || true); (go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@latest ./... > scan/sca.txt 2>&1 || true); echo scan-done; ls -la scan

with.task: Review the change on pull request #${inputs.number} for quality.
Review the change on pull request #${inputs.number} for security.

with.run: set -e; export HOME=/tmp GOCACHE=/tmp/gocache GOPATH=/tmp/go GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false; cd /workspace; TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#'); GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002; REPO='${inputs.repo}'; RID=$(curl -s --max-time 30 --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '\n' | grep "\"name\":\"$REPO\"" | sed -E 's/.*\"id\":\"([^\"]+)\".*/\1/' | head -1); [ -n "$RID" ] || { echo 'could not resolve repo id'; exit 1; }; mkdir -p /workspace/.prreview/out; echo '' | base64 -d > /workspace/.prreview/poster.go; go run /workspace/.prreview/poster.go /workspace/scan /workspace/.prreview/out /workspace/review-quality.md /workspace/review-security.md; fail=0; for f in /workspace/.prreview/out/comment-*.json; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/resp --max-time 60 --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --retry-all-errors -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "$GF/repos/$RID/pulls/${inputs.number}/comments" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d @"$f" || echo 000); echo "posted $f -> $code"; case "$code" in 2*) ;; *) fail=1;; esac; done; [ "$fail" = 0 ] || { echo 'one or more comments failed to post'; exit 1; }; echo report-done

cd /workspace; issues=$(cat review-security.md review-quality.md 2>/dev/null); if printf '%s' "$issues" | grep -qiE '\|[[:space:]]*(critical|high|medium)[[:space:]]*\|'; then fix=true; else fix=false; fi; echo "medium-or-above findings present: $fix"

inputs.task: Fix these review findings on this pull request. The tables below name the file, the line, the severity and the change to make -- address the medium, high and critical ones; leave the low ones. Update the plan, add or update the tests that pin each fix, and make them pass:\n\n${steps.gate.output.issues}
